content.thinking: Very fast because many queries zero coverage / duplicate masks. Need worst-case 20 unique nonzero masks. Construct profile signatures distinct via queries. With 8 profiles, 28 pair bits. Need 20 queries each with unique masks to force m=20. Hard via real zones but can craft. Even if m=20, 1M loop ~ maybe 0.5s. Let's benchmark minimum_basis directly with random masks/costs.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main
rng=random.Random(0)
full=(1<<28)-1
queries=[{'id':'q%02d'%i,'cost':rng.randint(1,1000)} for i in range(20)]
profiles=['p%d'%i for i in range(8)]
classes=[[p] for p in profiles]
# create random signatures so each query differs per pair according to cover
sigs={}
for q in queries:
    for p in profiles:
        sigs[(q['id'],p)]=0
# We'll instead monkey-use a fake minimum_basis by setting signatures so all pairs differ on every query => all masks same (dedupe to1)
# Directly test subset loop by copying logic with unique masks
masks=[rng.randrange(1,1<<28)| (1<<i) for i in range(20)]
costs=[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(20)]
size=1<<20
t=time.time()
coverage=[0]*size; total_cost=[0]*size; total_count=[0]*size
best=None; bestmask=0
for mask in range(size):
    if mask:
        low=mask&-mask; idx=low.bit_length()-1; prev=mask^low
        coverage[mask]=coverage[prev]|masks[idx]
        total_cost[mask]=total_cost[prev]+costs[idx]
        total_count[mask]=total_count[prev]+1
    if coverage[mask]==full:
        key=(total_cost[mask],total_count[mask])
        if best is None or key<best:
            best=key; bestmask=mask
print('time',time.time()-t,'best',best)
